title: Relief Reach of a Granted Employer Benefit Charging Protest, by Recorded Ground
content:
When a protest of Employer Benefit Charging charges is granted, the charges the relief reaches depend on the protest ground recorded on the position.

## Rule

Where the recorded protest ground disputes the employer's base-period wages or its base-period status, the relief reach is every charge posted on the claim times the wage-record relief share; where the recorded ground is that the benefits were paid in error by the agency or that a recovered overpayment was not credited, the relief reach is the total of the charges posted in the quarter of the statement the protest names; any other recorded ground takes in no charge already posted.

## Matrix

| Protest ground recorded on the position | Relief reach |
|---|---|
| This employer paid the claimant no base-period wages | Every charge posted on the claim, times the wage-record relief share |
| The base-period wages charged to this employer are wrong | Every charge posted on the claim, times the wage-record relief share |
| The benefits charged were paid in error by the agency | The total of the charges posted in the quarter of the statement the protest names |
| A recovered overpayment on the charged weeks has not been credited | The total of the charges posted in the quarter of the statement the protest names |
| Voluntary quit without good cause, discharge for misconduct, refused suitable work, continuing part-time employment, or no ground stated | No charge already posted |

## Terms used in the matrix

- **Every charge posted on the claim** — the total of all benefit charges posted to the employer's position on that claim, in every quarter, each at its posted amount.
- **The quarter of the statement the protest names** — the statement quarter recorded on the employer's protest submission for the position; where more than one protest submission is recorded, the most recently received one.
- **Charges posted in that quarter** — the benefit charges whose posting quarter is that statement quarter, each at its posted amount.

## Hypothetical illustration

A position carries charges of $600.00 posted in the first quarter and $450.00 posted in the second quarter, and the protest names the second-quarter statement.

- Recorded ground: benefits paid in error by the agency — relief reach $450.00.
- Recorded ground: base-period wages charged are wrong — relief reach is $1,050.00 times the wage-record relief share.
- Recorded ground: discharge for misconduct — relief reach $0.00.
